channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The conversion clock today is Texas process, not the rental book. ERCOT’s 3 Sep Market Notice M-A080326-04 finally issued Batch Zero conditional classifications to TSPs/DSPs — three days after the PUCT-authorized 31 Aug target — with verification, dynamic-model cures, and selective good-cause exceptions as the gates, and still no public MW list. Thursday’s PUCT open meeting (11 Sep) is set to take up the permanent ≥75 MW interconnection rule under Project 58481 (staff’s 3 Sep recommended final order cuts post-reservation deposit forfeiture from 80% to 20%) alongside 765 kV transmission items. The Silicon Tape is a clean confirm morning: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged; three NEW list prints (Crusoe A100 PCIe $2.00; DigitalOcean RTX 6000 Ada $1.57 and RTX 4000 Ada $0.76); zero ticks.

item.title: Compute brief — 9 September 2026
item.description: The conversion clock today is Texas process, not the rental book. ERCOT’s 3 Sep Market Notice M-A080326-04 finally issued Batch Zero conditional classifications to TSPs/DSPs — three days after the PUCT-authorized 31 Aug target — with verification, dynamic-model cures, and selective good-cause exceptions as the gates, and still no public MW list. Thursday’s PUCT open meeting (11 Sep) is set to take up the permanent ≥75 MW interconnection rule under Project 58481 (staff’s 3 Sep recommended final order cuts post-reservation deposit forfeiture from 80% to 20%) alongside 765 kV transmission items. The Silicon Tape is a clean confirm morning: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged; three NEW list prints (Crusoe A100 PCIe $2.00; DigitalOcean RTX 6000 Ada $1.57 and RTX 4000 Ada $0.76); zero ticks. Countries: United States / Texas: ERCOT M-A080326-04 (3 Sep): Batch Zero conditional classifications issued to TSPs/DSPs. PUCT Project 58481 permanent large-load rule on 11 Sep agenda; 59336 Howard–Solstice still HOLD. Malaysia: Firmus–OpenAI (8 Sep) still the live SEA print: two Malaysia AI Factory sites; OpenAI anchor; Firmus contracted capacity >900 MW portfolio-wide. Site MW and contract $ still undisclosed. United States / MISO: MISO IRR tariff at FERC ER26-3650 (filed 28 Aug): >50 MW large loads; ≥25 MW IT computational loads; Dec 4 effective ask; more filings by Nov 16. FERC stakeholder replies on RTO show-cause answers due 16 Sep.
